# Observed API contract overlays

This file records clean-room field observations that are not present in the generated Automate contract artifacts. It is intentionally separate from `rosetta.json` / `rosetta.md`, which are generated by `scripts/automate-capture/rosetta.py`.

Boundary:

- This is not an official Zscaler OpenAPI or OneAPI specification.
- This records observed read-side shape only unless a row explicitly says write-tested.
- Do not infer write support from this file.
- No tenant identifiers, object names, IDs, field values, or payload excerpts are retained here.

## ZIA Web DLP rule live-read fields

As of 2026-06-21, downstream clean-room validation reported two Web DLP rule fields in live read responses that were not present in the checked-in Automate contract, the same-day Playwright recapture of the Web DLP operation pages, the vendored Go SDK, the vendored Python SDK, or the Terraform provider.

| Field | API path | Observed surface | Automate contract status | Client/provider status | Write status | Consumer action |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deeplyNestedContentEnabled` (`deeply_nested_content_enabled`) | `/zia/api/v1/webDlpRules` | Live read response, values not retained | Absent from checked-in capture and 2026-06-21 recapture | Absent from Go SDK, Python SDK, and Terraform provider | Unknown | Treat as read-side known hold; do not add to writable config until Zscaler documents or write-tests it |
| `timeoutFailClosedEnabled` (`timeout_fail_closed_enabled`) | `/zia/api/v1/webDlpRules` | Live read response, values not retained | Absent from checked-in capture and 2026-06-21 recapture | Absent from Go SDK, Python SDK, and Terraform provider | Unknown | Treat as read-side known hold; do not add to writable config until Zscaler documents or write-tests it |

### Related provider gap

`dlpContentLocationsScopes` is a separate Web DLP field: it is present in the Automate contract and modeled by the Go and Python SDKs, but it was absent from the Terraform provider at the 2026-06-21 verification point. Do not conflate that documented provider gap with the two live-only observations above.
